protocol.description: This is the waylanad protocol for supporting tizen-specific screen which is the logical screen provided by Tizen Display Server.

interface.name: wtz_screen
interface.description: A screen describes rectangular area which can display on physical output devices of the compositor geometry. This object is published as global during start up, or when a compositor creates a screen.

enum.name: capability
enum.description: The functional capability type which a wtz_screen can support.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Notify when the server that it is not going to use the wtz_screen object anymore.

event.name: size
event.description: The size event describes the size of the screen. [TODO] example and scenario for this logical screen size event

event.name: name
event.description: Many compositors will assign names to their screen, show them to the user, allow them to be configured by name, etc.

event.name: capabilities

description.summary: an array of the capability which the screen support

event.description: Notify the array of the screen capabilities. The clients get this event when it binds the wtz_screen global resource.

request.name: get_splitscreen
request.description: Get the wtz_splitscreen when this wtz_screen has the splitscreen capability. When it has no splitscreen capability, not_supported error is raised.

request.name: assign_surface
request.description: Request to assign wtz_surface to the current screen.

event.name: surface_assigned

description.summary: Notification of a new surface assignment

event.description: Notifies that a new wtz_surface has been assigned to this screen. This event can be sent either as a response to the assign_surface request or triggered by the display server's internal operations.

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: The wtz_surface object that has been assigned to this screen.

event.name: seat_assigned
event.description: Notifies that a wl_seat has been assigned to this screen. This event can be sent when a client binds the wtz_screen global resource or triggered by the display server's internal operations.

arg.name: seat
arg.summary: The wl_seat object assigned to this screen.

interface.name: wtz_splitscreen
interface.description: The wtz_splitscreen is for managing split regions of the target wtz_screen. This interface can get get_splitscreen request of the wtz_screen.

event.name: region
event.description: Notify the splitscreen region that partial rectangle area of the wtz_screen. The event can be repeated during all of the region information send to client.

interface.name: wtz_splitscreen_region
interface.description: The wtz_splitscreen_region interface for request and receive the information of the target region. The interface only can get information. And the setting of the splitscreen region is depends on the implementation of the display server.

event.name: name
event.description: Send name of the wtz_splitscreen_region in a screen.

event.name: geometry
event.description: Send geometry of the wtz_splitscreen_region in a screen.

request.name: assign_appid
request.description: Request to assign appid to the splitscreen region.

interface.name: wtz_shell
interface.description: wtz_shell allows clients to turn a wl_surface into a wtz_surface which can support the Tizen features in Tizen Dispaly Server.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this wtz_shell object. Notify when the server that it is not going to use the wtz_shell object anymore.

request.name: get_wtz_surface

description.summary: create a tizen shell surface from a surface

request.description: This creates a wtz_surface for the given surface.

interface.name: wtz_surface
interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for implementations that provide a tizen-specific user interface.

enum.name: decoration_type
enum.description: This describes the type of decoration.

event.name: decoration
event.description: Notify this event when the decoration type of the wtz_surface has been decided or changed.

event.name: screen

description.summary: tizen screen which this surface locates

event.description: Notify this event when this surface is assigned in the screen. This event will alternate with the wtz_surface@surface_assigned event.
